article_title: Could your tattoo stop you from getting a job?

tasks.prompt: What central question does the article explore?
options: Whether tattoos should be banned in public places
Whether growing acceptance of tattoos has eliminated workplace bias and career limits
How to become a professional tattoo artist
Why every employer now requires visible tattoos
tasks.correct_answer: Whether growing acceptance of tattoos has eliminated workplace bias and career limits
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת את הפער בין הפיכת הקעקועים למיינסטרים לבין דעות קדומות ומגבלות שעדיין קיימות בשוק העבודה.

tasks.prompt: According to the YouGov evidence discussed, which tattoos remain less accepted in many professions?
options: Small tattoos covered by clothing
Temporary tattoos used in research
Visible face and neck tattoos
Tattoos on people working in creative fields only
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסקר מצא קבלה רחבה יחסית לקעקועים גלויים, אך קעקועים בפנים ובצוואר עדיין מתקבלים פחות במקצועות רבים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “stigma” mean?
options: A formal job qualification
A growing fashion trend
A legal protection against dismissal
A negative social label that can lead to unfair judgement
tasks.correct_answer: A negative social label that can lead to unfair judgement
tasks.explanation_hebrew: stigma היא תווית חברתית שלילית שעלולה לגרום לכך שאדם ייתפס כלא מקצועי או יישפט באופן לא הוגן.

tasks.prompt: What concern did recruitment director Ben Davis-Rice express about highly visible tattoos?
options: They may restrict the careers a person can enter
They always improve a candidate's salary
They are illegal in customer-facing work
They prevent someone from learning professional skills
tasks.correct_answer: They may restrict the careers a person can enter
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הוא טען שקעקועים באזורים בולטים במיוחד עלולים לצמצם את מגוון הקריירות הזמינות, גם כאשר עמדות כלליות נעשות פתוחות יותר.

tasks.prompt: Why can the same tattoo be viewed differently in a design studio and a traditional customer-facing role?
options: Tattoo ink changes colour in offices
Ideas of professionalism and brand fit vary between industries and audiences
Creative workers never meet customers
Employment law gives artists different skin rights
tasks.correct_answer: Ideas of professionalism and brand fit vary between industries and audiences
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המשמעות שמייחסים לקעקוע תלויה בהקשר: בתחום יצירתי הוא עשוי לשדר מקוריות, ובתפקיד מסורתי להיתפס כלא מקצועי או מאיים.

tasks.prompt: What does “gatekeepers” refer to in a discussion of recruitment?
options: People who physically guard office doors
Tattoo artists who choose designs
People such as recruiters and managers who control access to opportunities
Survey respondents who refuse to answer
tasks.correct_answer: People such as recruiters and managers who control access to opportunities
tasks.explanation_hebrew: gatekeepers הם שומרי סף — מגייסים ומנהלים שמחליטים מי מתקדם בתהליך הקבלה ולכן יכולים להשפיע על הזדמנויות.

tasks.prompt: Give two pieces of evidence that workplace attitudes toward tattoos are changing but remain uneven.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג ראיה אחת לקבלה גוברת וראיה אחת להמשך הסתייגות או אפליה.
expected_points: Most respondents accepted visible tattoos in the professions surveyed
Younger adults were generally more accepting than older groups
Face and neck tattoos remained less acceptable
Some candidates still worry that highly visible tattoos will harm their job prospects

tasks.prompt: Summarise the article's argument about tattoos, professionalism and employment in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב את הנורמליזציה של קעקועים, ההבדלים בין ענפים, תפקידם של שומרי הסף והמשך הסטיגמה.
expected_points: Tattoos have moved from counterculture toward the mainstream
General acceptance has increased, especially among younger people
Placement, content, industry and customer expectations still shape perceptions
Recruiters and employers can translate stereotypes into restricted opportunities
Professional ability and appearance are not necessarily connected

tasks.prompt: How could a strict tattoo policy reduce both discrimination and authenticity, depending on how it is designed?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את המתח בין כלל אחיד לבין חופש הביטוי, ולהבחין בין תוכן פוגעני לעצם קיומו של קעקוע.
expected_points: A clear rule can reduce arbitrary decisions by individual managers
A blanket ban can suppress harmless self-expression and exclude qualified candidates
Policies can focus narrowly on offensive content or genuine role requirements
Transparent and consistent standards are less discriminatory than vague ideas of professionalism

tasks.prompt: Propose a fair workplace policy for visible tattoos and justify it using the article's evidence.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע מדיניות ישימה, עקבית ומידתית ולנמק אותה באמצעות המתח בין קבלה גוברת לחששות תעסוקתיים.
expected_points: Allow visible tattoos by default because they do not determine competence
Restrict only clearly offensive content or cases with a specific evidence-based requirement
Apply the same written standard across candidates and employees
Provide a review process so subjective stereotypes do not decide careers
